method: Least squares on the log of estimate / published over each family's usable rows (tools/bench.mjs): llama-bench pp (a prompt from an empty context) and tg (generation from an empty context), plain decoding, f16 KV, the row's micro-batch. Nelder-Mead in log space from a grid of starts, with a weak pull (weight 0.0002) towards {"bwEff":0.6,"computeEff":0.3,"layerMs":0.02,"moeLayerMs":0.02,"moeComputeEff":0.75} so a factor the rows cannot pin stays put. Of rows measuring the same thing only the newest build is kept (flash attention on, on a tie); builds before 2025-01-01 get a fitted build term (oldBuild) where the family also has newer rows. The reference ThinkPad is never fitted.
